name: Duck Fat
siboNotes: Pure animal fats are FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. High in calories, so use moderately to avoid slowing gastric motility.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator for up to 6 months or freeze for longer storage
Excellent for high-heat cooking and roasting vegetables
Let solidify at room temperature for easy measuring
Strain through fine mesh if rendering your own to remove any meat particles
pairsWellWith: roasted root vegetables like carrots and parsnips
lean proteins like chicken or beef
fresh herbs like rosemary and thyme
